lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in at least four distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. These clusters are staggered across the mid-lateral flank with higher density observed in the columns immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs to create a coordinate-like grid structure on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (high luminance on top, low luminance/shadow below).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, semi-circular notch is visible on the trailing edge of the pectoral fin, disrupting the smooth contour of the fin's macro-mask.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple smaller, elongated silhouettes (remoras) are visible in close proximity to the ventral surface, exhibiting a distinct contrast against the surrounding water column.
